pages.text: $(thing)Patchouli$() is optional and supplies this in-game manual. Tobacconist's gameplay itself is not meant to require Patchouli. The manual recipe and contents are conditionally loaded when Patchouli is present.

$(thing)Curios$() is optional. With it installed, you gain the Head and Mouth accessory slots. Without it, Spectacles use the vanilla head slot and smoking still works through ordinary right-click use.
pages.title: Curios

pages.text: $(thing)JEI$() is optional. It provides recipe browsing and Tobacconist custom recipe categories, but every gameplay workflow needed to use the mod is described in this manual so JEI is not required as documentation.
pages.title: JEI

pages.text: Flavoring ingredients are $(thing)tag-driven$(). Tobacconist accepts matching common ingredient tags plus optional items from Farmer's Delight, Fruits Delight, Croptopia, Neapolitan, HerbalBrews, Expanded Delight, Rustic Delight, Coffee Delight, Create Confectionery, and other correctly tagged food mods. These integrations never make those mods required.
pages.title: Flavor Compatibility
